reach: Only what a translator can reach counts (owner, 2026-10-19: testing what cannot happen in the app wastes tokens). A scenario is reachable when it is made of steps through the app's own screens and API as docs/APP-DESIGN.md and tC4's docs/JOURNEYS.md describe, plus these outside events and nothing else: the app or the computer stopping at any moment (crash, kill, power cut), another program editing or holding a file the app wrote in a project, a teammate's work arriving by Door43 sync or a USB exchange file, a full disk, and the network dropping. A translator never picks where a project goes (every way in uses the one projects folder), never edits the app's own data files by hand, and runs one instance per computer. A finding whose preconditions need anything else is not a finding: drop it, do not log it as a minor, and do not write tests or property-test steps for it.

c4.report:
C4 (Check writes) is done on branch rl-c4 in /home/bot/tc-rst/.worktrees/resume-build-lane/target/lanes/c4. Every test the row's "done when" names passes and is committed. Nothing was merged or pushed.

**Commits**
- Three commits from before the usage limit: c7a9663 (the check comment is drafted on the server while it is typed), 8cea3e9 (a change re-assesses only the checks it reaches) and f9019b7 (a translator can mark, select and comment on a story's checks). ddb8ab2 merged C3 into the lane.
- 5b36d3f: new browser journeys, a fix for a stuck overlay, and the design text.
- d6197f0: C4 added to the units that have landed, and six screens captured again.
- dd2fd30: the final results recorded in .audit/plans/C4.md.

**How the "done when" is met.** The new file is parity/app/journeys/check-writes.test.mjs; it runs on the real store.
- **J4:** mark valid on words selected by dragging, then add a comment and a bookmark. All three end up in one record in ingredients/checking/translationNotes/TIT.json, and TIT.usfm keeps the same bytes. They survive reopening, and clearing the comment stores `comments: false`.
- **J6:** the stored decision on Titus 1:1 selects "Dios". After that word is edited out in Translate, the check is flagged invalid, and the notice and the red row show. The decision is kept with userStatus valid and its token is unchanged, so the verse save wrote nothing on it.
- **J22:** a story check marked in the browser is stored under {story:1, frame:1} with its word, and the story file is unchanged. A later edit of the frame flags the check and keeps it.
- **check-project-switch (#434):** stories, then Bible, then stories in one run; each check list uses its own project's resources. A project card that reopens straight into a tool does the same.
- **check-returns-draft (#532):** a story frame drafted in Translate shows on the return to Check. B5b already covered the Bible half.
- **Late draft (DELTA-10-16:906-907):** no code was needed. A check shown before its verse has text shows the text when it arrives, with no click, and the journey proves it. In that journey the text arrives through an `editor/saveVerse` call made outside the page, as the translate and #532 journeys already do.
- `decision_serializes_one_row`, `decision_refetches_no_rail` and `verse_edit_reassesses_its_checks_only` pass on Psalms and ten times Psalms, alongside 28 other tc-app check tests.

**Bug found and fixed (blocker for the translator's view).** If the person pressed a mode tab after a story project's tabs appeared but before its story had loaded, the "opening the project" overlay stayed up for good. It covered the whole window and held the keyboard, so only a restart got them out. Now any mode switch removes that overlay (crates/tc-ui/src/app/web/app_ctx.rs, `Actions::go`). The regression journey `a_mode_tab_pressed_before_the_story_is_read_leaves_no_open_overlay` slows the story load and fails without the fix.

**Tests**
- Full gate, logged in .enjoy-logs/resume-c4-full.log in the lane worktree: it ends ALL_GATES_PASSED unit=c4 at d6197f0. It covered formatting, all the clippy lines (workspace, both release lines without test hooks, tc-ui wasm with none, gallery, app and test-hooks, tc-api wasm), 3,277 Rust tests with 0 failed and 7 ignored, the builds, and 24 journeys.
- 69 journeys passed on the same code across check-writes, check-detail, check-keyboard, check-picker, story, story-writes, understand, translate and guided-fix (.enjoy-logs/c4-journeys.log).
- The 48-test screen gate passes.

**Screens and parity record**
- C4 is now listed in parity/app/units.json.
- check-picker, en-check-picker, check-tn-session, en-check-tw-session and en-check-tn-session were captured again; the only change is the build folder's name.
- en-obs-check-tn-session now matches tC4's pixels exactly. Its DOM still differs in two attributes the Bible check sessions already declare: #764's progress-bar label and #762's 80-character width for "Your translation" (tC4 9ad4d5c). Its residual was rewritten to say that, replacing "until C4".

**Design text changed**
- docs/APP-DESIGN.md: the C4 row now records what was built, as D1 to D6 (server draft, re-assessment, writable story checks, late draft, the overlay fix, journeys and captures). B7's `storyItem` endpoint is gone from the check endpoint list, because item, article and decide now take a story's list. B7's D7 points to C4 D3.
- docs/TC4-ISSUES.md: the C4 line for #532 now says done.
- .audit/plans/C4.md: what was done after resuming, and where the results are.

**What is left:** nothing in the row. There is no new declared difference: saving a check comment when the checker moves on is Q-25's, which is already declared and answered. .audit/STATUS.md (generated) and the RESUME file are untouched, for the orchestrator.
